name: ePDFView-gtk3
title: ePDFView-gtk3-20200814
summary: ePDFView-gtk3 is a fork of the old ePDFView program. Although the github repository https://github.com/Flow-It/epdfview_old.git names it as 'old', it is the gtk3 fork. It is a lightweight replacement for Evince as it does not rely upon GNOME libraries and is more capable than MuPDF .
